Example calculation of low energy availability:
• 60 kg female with 20% body fat = 12 kg fat mass (FM) and 48 kg fat-free mass 
(FFM) 
• Her daily energy intake is restricted to 1800 kcal 
• Energy cost of exercise =  500 kcal  
• Energy availability = Energy intake – Energy cost of Exercise  
o 1800 kcal intake - 500 kcal energy cost during exercise = 1300 kcal of 
energy available for the remaining 4 major metabolic activities (growth, 
cellular maintenance, reproduction, thermoregulation)
